{{Quote|Is there a favorite?''"<br />"''Deca Brun is favored. He's a hero to the galacian people. He promises them reform and prosperity. It won't be that easy, but he makes it sound so.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" />}}
'''Deca Brun''' ran for [[Governor/Legends|governor]] in the [[Galacian Gubernatorial election, 44 BBY|Galacian Gubernatorial election]]<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" /> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> He received widespread support, as he promised reform and prosperity. However, Brun had made a deal with [[Offworld Mining Corporation]], promising them exclusive mining rights which would have caused extensive environmental damage in exchange for campaign funding. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered this deal, and this was revealed before the election. Thus [[Wila Prammi]], another candidate, won the election by a vast majority.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" />
